# PythonTutorials.net

> A comprehensive Python learning platform offering tutorials, interactive tools, and assessments for web frameworks, machine learning, and data science libraries.

PythonTutorials.net provides beginner-friendly guides and hands-on quizzes covering Django, Flask, NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, NLTK, and Pillow. The site includes an online Python compiler for immediate code execution and testing.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Django
- Flask
- NumPy
- Pandas
- Scikit-Learn
- NLTK
- Pillow
- ORM
- Machine Learning
- Data Analysis
- Web Development
- Image Processing
- Natural Language Processing
- REST APIs

## Getting Started

- [PythonTutorials.net Homepage](https://www.pythontutorials.net): Homepage for PythonTutorials.net with Python, Django, Flask, and ML tutorials.
- [Online Python Compiler](https://www.pythontutorials.net/online-python-compiler): Free browser-based Python 3 compiler for learning and code execution.

## Web Development Frameworks

- [Getting Started with Django: A Beginner's Guide](https://www.pythontutorials.net/django): Beginner's guide to Django web framework covering MVT architecture and ORM.
- [Getting Started with Python Flask: A Beginner's Guide](https://www.pythontutorials.net/flask): Beginner's guide to Flask microframework with routing and Jinja2 templating.
- [Building REST APIs with Django Rest Framework](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/building-rest-apis-with-django-rest-framework): Quiz on Django REST Framework serializers, viewsets, and authentication.
- [Django Fundamentals](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/django-fundamentals): Quiz covering Django models, views, templates, ORM, and middleware.
- [Django ORM Mastery](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/django-orm-mastery): Quiz on Django ORM, QuerySets, and database query optimization.
- [Flask Web Development](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/flask-web-development): Quiz assessing Flask routing, request handling, and Jinja2 templating.
- [Flask API Design and Testing](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/flask-api-design-and-testing): Quiz on Flask REST API design, documentation, and testing with pytest.
- [Flask Extensions and Middleware](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/flask-extensions-and-middleware): Quiz covering Flask extensions, blueprints, and middleware architecture.

## Machine Learning & Data Science

- [Getting Started with Scikit-learn: A Beginner's Guide](https://www.pythontutorials.net/scikit-learn): Machine learning tutorial covering Scikit-learn classification, regression, clustering.
- [Getting Started with NumPy: A Beginner's Guide](https://www.pythontutorials.net/numpy): NumPy guide for scientific computing with arrays and mathematical functions.
- [Data Analysis with NumPy and Pandas](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/data-analysis-with-numpy-and-pandas): Quiz testing NumPy and Pandas skills in data manipulation and analysis.
- [Feature Engineering in Scikit-Learn](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/feature-engineering-in-scikit-learn): Quiz on Scikit-Learn feature preprocessing, scaling, and selection.
- [End-to-End Machine Learning Project](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/end-to-end-machine-learning-project): ML project quiz covering preprocessing, modeling, and deployment workflows.

## Natural Language Processing & Image Processing

- [Getting Started with NLTK: A Beginner's Guide to Natural Language Toolkit](https://www.pythontutorials.net/nltk): Natural Language Processing tutorial with NLTK tokenization and sentiment analysis.
- [Getting Started with Pillow: A Beginner's Guide to Image Processing in Python](https://www.pythontutorials.net/pillow): Image processing guide with Pillow library for resizing, cropping, and filtering.
- [Image Processing with Pillow](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/image-processing-with-pillow): Quiz on Pillow image transformations, filtering, and format conversions.
- [Advanced Image Manipulation in Pillow](https://www.pythontutorials.net/quiz/advanced-image-manipulation-in-pillow): Quiz assessing Pillow skills in color modes, masks, and composite images.

## Community & Resources

- [Blog](https://www.pythontutorials.net/blog): Blog archive featuring Python tutorials on data, web, and command-line topics.
